findings.title: Registered metric alert handler is now uninstantiable
findings.body: `MetricAlertDetectorHandler` now subclasses `StatefulDetectorHandler` but implements none of its abstract members (`counter_names`, `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values`, and `build_occurrence_and_event_data`). Because `MetricAlertFire` registers this class as its `detector_handler`, accessing `detector.detector_handler` for a metric-alert detector will raise `TypeError` instead of returning a handler, causing detector processing to fail. Keep this handler on the non-stateful base until it is implemented, or provide all required implementations.

findings.title: Evaluate documentation still describes the old list return type
findings.body: `StatefulDetectorHandler.evaluate` now returns a dictionary keyed by group key, but its docstring says it "returns a list of `DetectorEvaluationResult`". This is the public extension point for detector implementations, so the stale documentation can cause new handlers to implement or consume the previous contract incorrectly.
